mentions.name: Native macOS/Android surveillance camera apps
mentions.description: This project reverse engineers the streaming protocols of cheap surveillance cameras so their proprietary vendor apps can be replaced with native, faster apps for macOS and Android. A native macOS and Android app has been completed for one camera brand, with work continuing on the remaining two brands.
mentions.problem: Each camera brand ships its own awful app and none offer a native desktop macOS app.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm reverse engineering the streaming protocol for three different brands of cheap surveillance video cameras. Each brand has its own app. They're all awful. None of them have a native desktop MacOS app. I've successfully created a native app for MacOS and Android for one of the brands. They're faster and work better than the ones they're replacing. One down, two to go.
